generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A producer can emit an internally consistent handoff using an obsolete contract revision that the current independent consumer must reject.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat any syntactically valid ready certificate as compatible without comparing its contract revision to the active consumer contract.

reusable_control.purpose: Require exact producer/consumer contract-version parity before audit handoff.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: The handoff builder must default to and emit the active delivery contract revision, never a remembered historical constant.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: The independent preflight must compare certificate contract_version to its own active contract and fail closed on mismatch.

transfer_cases.procedure: Generate a legacy-version fixture and verify the current producer path emits only the active contract.
Present an obsolete ready certificate to the current validator and require rejection.

skill_changes.change: Current entregar-issue build_handoff_certificate defaults to contract 2026-08-20.3.
Current auditar-issue handoff validation rejects certificate contract mismatch.
